selection_rule: Wait for both fixed source studies to finish. Consider only settings preserving every timed and pitch-only validation recording at both policies. Select exactly one V48 member by the A key and exactly one V51 member by the B key. If either has no preserving setting, stop this ensemble study. No other source study or runner-up is substituted.
composition: Each member uses its own verified checkpoint normalizer and fixed learned inference path. For each complete-input candidate, request additional removal if either member passes its own rejection threshold and independent frame absence veto. At the stricter policy, each member uses threshold + .005 capped at .9999 and veto * .8. Combined output probabilities are deterministic KEEP/REMOVE; evaluate at .5. Intersect with immutable corresponding V43 permissions and run V38 on the complete pre-deletion context. Retained clocks remain unchanged. No reference, filename, corpus/source ID or absolute pitch is an inference input.
validation_gate: Evaluate the single fixed pair jointly on all 381 timed and 237 pitch-only validation recordings. Require every existing per-recording identity, pitch, timing, chord, repeat, hold and unsupported-duration preservation check at both policies. Require strictly positive overall, real-piano, NRG-CP and isolated-pitch extra-note gains at both policies, and zero restorations. Individually preserving members do not prove joint preservation.
subsequent_gate: Freeze the one joint winner, then all 603 consumed regressions at both policies, then one untouched 40-clip original/texture MP3 first pass with seeds 297101-297140 cycling 48/128/192 kbps and separate positive family gains. No runner-up, retuning or replacement fresh clips after failure. Portable physical/runtime parity and native functional checks required before any release.
